name: excluded-only-upper-permits-only-lower-leaf-outside-invalid
description: Root carries only excludedSubtrees (excludes evil.com). The accumulated permitted_subtrees state is the universal set (no DNS permit yet). An intermediate then introduces a non-empty permittedSubtrees with only good.com. Per RFC 5280 6.1.4(g)(1), intersecting the universal set with {good.com} must yield {good.com}; the leaf SAN attacker.com is outside that permit and must be rejected. GnuTLS <=3.8.12 returned early when the accumulated permitted state was empty, leaving the path effectively constrained only by exclusions — so a leaf for attacker.com was accepted.
